name: Medicine Ball Overhead Throw
steps: Stand facing a sturdy wall or open space with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a medicine ball with both hands.
Drop into a slight athletic squat while sweeping the medicine ball up overhead behind your head with your elbows slightly bent.
Drive explosively upward through your legs, hips, and core as you whip the ball powerfully forward from overhead.
Catch the rebound or retrieve the ball safely, reset your athletic stance, and perform the next throw.
tips: Brace your abs firmly as the ball goes overhead so your lower back does not arch sharply.
Coordinate your leg drive and arm snap so the whole body powers the throw.
